title: Gmail Bostonians or any Chicago contact
prompt: Return the names of contacts whose email is a gmail address AND who live in Boston, OR who live in Chicago (regardless of email).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE contacts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT, city TEXT); INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (1,'Anna Smith','anna.smith@gmail.com','Boston'),(2,'Ben Stone','ben@yahoo.com','Chicago'),(3,'Cara Jones','cara.jones@gmail.com','Boston'),(4,'Drew Ng','drew@gmail.com','Denver'),(5,'Elin Park','elin.park@hotmail.com','Chicago');
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM contacts WHERE (email LIKE '%gmail.com' AND city = 'Boston') OR city = 'Chicago';
